identificationModule.briefTitle: SCTB41 Plus SCTB39G With or Without Standard Therapy in Advanced Solid Tumors
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open Multi-center Phase I/II Study to Evaluate the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Preliminary Efficacy of SCTB41 in Combination With SCTB39G With or Without Standard Therapy in Adult Patients With Advanced Malignant Solid Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study aims to evaluate the safety, tolerability, PK characteristics, immunogenicity, and preliminary anti-tumor efficacy of SCTB41 in combination with SCTB39G with or without standard therapy in adult patients with advanced malignant solid tumors. This study is an open label, multicentre, dose-escalation and dose-expansion Phase I/II clinical trial.

interventions.name: SCTB41+SCTB39G
interventions.description: SCTB41 plus SCTB39G of different doses, IV, every 3 weeks

primaryOutcomes.description: Incidence of dose-limiting toxicities up to the Day 21 visit
The ORR is defined as the proportion of subjects with confirmed CR or confirmed PR, based on RECIST Version 1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The DCR is defined as the proportion of subjects with CR, PR, or SD based on RECIST Version 1.1.
The PFS is defined as the time from the start of treatment until the first documentation of disease progression or death due to any cause, whichever occurs first.
Overall survival is defined as the time from the start of treatment until death due to any cause.
